description: Cookie consent with Google Consent Mode v2, script blocking, Cookiebot migration, and installation without an account. Previously named Kindnod; the published npm package remains @kindnod/consent.
rules: Use the complete inline consent initialization and async banner snippet in README.md before Google tags or GTM. A standalone async script tag cannot guarantee consent initialization order. No account or key is needed to install.

For React or Next.js, the published package is @kindnod/consent. Render KindnodConsent from @kindnod/consent/react with src="https://tryshortbread.com/shortbread.js". The renamed @shortbread/consent package is not yet published as of 2026-10-26.
Do not add a Cookiebot, CookieYes, or other consent script alongside Shortbread.
Mark non-essential scripts type="text/plain" data-cookieconsent="statistics" or "marketing". Follow https://tryshortbread.com/docs for tag ordering and platform-specific setup.
For React, include the same inline initialization in the server-rendered head. Configure GTM consent checks and triggers; Consent Mode does not block every tracker automatically.
